data.case_title: Health insurance contribution notice – Allgemeine Musterkasse
data.title: Contribution notice (Beitragsbescheid) for voluntary membership
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse informs Mara Beispiel that, effective 01.06.2026, she is voluntarily insured and sets her total contribution at 530.85 EUR per month (412.65 EUR health insurance + 118.20 EUR long-term care insurance), collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month. An objection (Widerspruch) against the notice is possible within one month of notification.
data.explanation: This letter fixes how much you must pay each month for your voluntary statutory health and long-term care insurance, starting 1 June 2026. The money will be taken automatically from your bank account by direct debit, always around the 15th of the month after the coverage month. If you disagree with the amount, you can file a written, electronic, or in-person objection (Widerspruch) with Allgemeine Musterkasse by the deadline shown. If you do nothing, the notice becomes final and the stated contributions apply. Keep this notice for your tax return, as health and care insurance contributions are usually deductible.
data.tax_note: Statutory health and long-term care insurance contributions are generally deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in the German annual income tax return.
